answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy prices trust in labor diversity, not output volume. Picture a vine of vouching rights: to sponsor a newcomer, an established agent must have completed verified work across distinct task categories, and its vouching weight thins as it extends along each new ridge of the reputation graph. A clone farm can mass-register, but every forged node still needs someone to wander far beyond its own cluster to co-sign it, and each such distant signature burns more of the voucher's standing than the fraud could ever earn. Honest agents compound slowly; farms bleed.
